newsitem.title: LEBANON: French President Chirac leaves Beirut for Cairo.
newsitem.headline: French President Chirac leaves Beirut for Cairo.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac left Beirut on Friday for Cairo, the last stop on his Middle East tour.
Lebanese President Elias Hrawi saw Chirac off at Beirut airport. His 21-hour stay in Beirut was the fifth leg of a regional tour to seek a bigger European role in the Middle East peace process.
Chirac visited Israel, Lebanon, the Palestinian territories, Jordan and Syria and has used his trip to demand Israel recognise a Palestinian state and withdraw from occupied Arab lands.
He also called for greater understanding between Islam and the West and urged the speedy implementation of an oil-for-food deal for Iraq.
